newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering - Q1 profits up 10 to 15 percent.
newsitem.headline: Schering - Q1 profits up 10 to 15 percent.

text.p: German drugs group Schering AG said on Wednesday that its profits for the first quarter of 1997 had risen between 10 and 15 percent from a year earlier, while group sales were up 21 percent.
The firm also said that the currenct dollar/mark exchange rate would boost profits for the year as whole by around 10 to 15 percent.
Schering's board chairman Giuseppe Vita told the firm's annual meeting that the first three months of this year had developed very favourably due to the dollar/mark level.
The mark has weakened substantially against the dollar in recent months and was trading at 1.7275 in mid-morning trade on Wednesday.
In 1996, Schering said its total sales were 5.27 billion marks ($3.1 billion) -- a figure which Vita said would this year rise by 14 percent to around six billion marks.
